scripts.title: Cappadocia Balloon Panic
scripts.rawText:
[INTENT]
Create a live-action and 3D-animation clay hybrid comedy scene set inside a low-drifting hot air balloon wicker basket skimming past Cappadocia fairy chimneys in Turkey, featuring @image2 as ARTHUR and half-sized clay companion @image1 as UMA as a sudden crosswind sends them careening toward a rock spire.

[LOGIC]
Maintain a consistent left-to-right flight trajectory past the fairy chimneys, keeping Arthur positioned frame-left facing screen-right and half-sized Uma positioned frame-right facing screen-left until Uma slides across the basket floor. Keep the overhead propane burner rope in Arthur's right hand and his left hand anchored to the wicker rim, while Uma wears a tilted burgundy Turkish fez and Arthur wears no head accessory. No subtitles appear on screen.

[AESTHETIC]
Medium: 35mm live-action cinematography seamlessly blended with tactile stop-motion clay animation for Uma, subtle thumbprint clay texture and matte sheen
Palette: warm Cappadocia sunrise amber, dusty terracotta rock, mustard yellow, turquoise, deep burgundy
Lighting: golden low-angle Turkish sunrise from screen-right, intermittent warm orange propane burner flare from overhead
Location: wicker hot air balloon basket drifting above rugged volcanic fairy chimneys and sunlit valleys in Cappadocia, Turkey
Wardrobe: Arthur in a mustard-yellow linen tourist shirt with rolled sleeves, khaki cargo shorts, woven leather belt, and no head accessory; Uma in a miniature turquoise embroidered Turkish waistcoat over a cream cotton shirt, brown trousers, and a tilted burgundy felt fez with a black tassel
Audio: crisp high-altitude morning wind, creaking wicker, intermittent propane burner hiss

[OPENING]
MS at eye level inside the wicker hot air balloon basket against a golden Cappadocia sunrise sky and distant fairy chimneys. Frame-left midground, Arthur stands facing screen-right with the overhead burner rope in his right hand and his left hand on the wicker rim. Frame-right foreground, Uma, half Arthur's height, stands atop an overturned wooden fruit crate facing screen-left with both hands on the wicker rim and a burgundy fez tilted on his clay curls.

[EXECUTION]
[CAM 01] MS, inside wicker basket against Cappadocia sky -> [BLOCK] Arthur frame-left MG facing screen-right; Uma frame-right FG atop overturned wooden crate facing screen-left -> [ACT] Arthur, burner rope in his right hand and left hand on the wicker rim, grins nervously toward Uma; Uma, both hands on the wicker rim and burgundy fez tilted on his clay curls, squints up at the overhead burner -> Arthur says strained cheer {Smooth sailing, little buddy!} -> [ACT] Uma taps the wicker rim with his right hand while keeping his left hand on the rim and glances nervously over the edge toward the approaching rock spire
[CAM 01] -> [BLOCK] Arthur frame-left MG facing screen-right; Uma frame-right FG atop wooden crate facing screen-left -> [ACT] Uma, both hands on the wicker rim, leans back as a sudden crosswind tilts the basket and his burgundy fez slips forward over his eyes; Arthur, burner rope in his right hand and left hand on the rim, braces his boots wide against the tilting floor -> <creaking wicker and snapping canvas overhead> -> Uma says muffled, frantic {I cannot see! The rock is right there!} -> [ACT] Uma's feet slip off the crate and he slides across the wicker floor toward frame-left, grabbing Arthur's khaki shorts with both hands
[CAM 02] CU on Arthur and Uma at hip level -> [BLOCK] Arthur frame-left MG facing down toward screen-right; Uma frame-center FG at Arthur's hip facing screen-left -> [ACT] Arthur, left hand clamped on the wicker rim, yanks the burner rope down hard with his right hand while Uma clings to Arthur's shorts with both hands and shoves his burgundy fez back onto his forehead with his chin -> <roaring propane burner blast> -> [LIGHT] warm orange flame light flashes downward across Arthur's torso and Uma's clay brow -> Arthur says shouting over the roar {Hold onto the belt, not the shorts!} -> [ACT] Uma scrambles up onto Arthur's right boot and clutches Arthur's woven leather belt with both hands
[CAM 01] TILTING UP slightly -> [BLOCK] Arthur frame-left MG facing screen-right; Uma frame-center FG perched on Arthur's right boot facing screen-left -> [ACT] Arthur, burner rope in his right hand and left hand on the wicker rim, releases the rope as the basket surges upward past a towering fairy chimney spire; Uma, both hands locked on Arthur's belt and his burgundy fez tilted crookedly, peeks wide-eyed over the wicker rim -> <whooshing morning wind fading into distant bird calls> -> Uma says breathless, deadpan {Next time we take the bus.} -> [ACT] Arthur laughs, pats Uma's shoulder with his right hand while keeping his left hand on the wicker rim, and glances ahead toward the valley
